title: Book an appointment from the record
summary: Create → Appointment: the appointment card comes with the patient already filled in.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Appointment
steps.details: Opens the new appointment card for this patient.

steps.title: Save the appointment
steps.details: You're warned if the time is taken or outside the calendar.
